# Backchannel v0.1.1

This release focuses on call continuity, readable analysis, more stable
speaker attribution, and a quieter desktop launch experience.

## Highlights

- Increased light-mode surface contrast and repaired low-contrast status tags
  in dark-mode Administration views.
- Rendered meeting-chat replies as GitHub-flavored Markdown, added bounded
  per-session follow-up history, and added a Reset chat control.
- Hid Enhanced insight filters and badges until the explicit speaker-context
  enhancement pass has run.
- Preserved the active call timer, WebSocket ownership, audio capture, and
  input meters while navigating to other sessions and back.
- Reduced runaway speaker creation by requiring longer evidence for new voice
  profiles, bounding profile counts, tuning similarity matching, and enabling
  echo/noise suppression when system audio is captured.
- Prevented bundled PostgreSQL child processes from opening a blank Windows
  console window.
- Changed desktop browser URLs from numeric `127.0.0.1` addresses to the
  friendlier `localhost` name and expanded tray actions.

## Downloads

- `Backchannel-windows-x64.zip` - Windows 10 or later, x64
- `Backchannel-macos-arm64.zip` - macOS on Apple Silicon

Both desktop bundles are unsigned. Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper
may require first-run confirmation. Docker Compose remains the full
self-hosted path and receives this version by rebuilding from the `v0.1.1`
source tag.
